Smelts steel and the tier alloys, with slag as a by-product.
It has four inputs: the metal (iron for steel), two additive slots for the alloys (leave them empty for steel; the two additives go in either way round), and coal coke. Coal coke is both its fuel and its reagent: burning it heats the furnace toward 1,600°C, and it keeps back what each smelt uses. Coal coke blocks work as nine coal coke.
Each recipe needs the furnace hot enough: steel from 1,200°C, the alloys from 1,200 to 1,500°C. Graphite (for battery anodes) is baked here too, from 1,500°C: Coal Coke or 2 Carbon Dust in the metal slot give 1 Graphite. Put one Coal Coke in the metal slot by hand to start it: coke that comes in through a port goes to the fuel slot unless the metal slot already holds coke.
A fluorite crystal as the additive fluxes steel: 4 iron + 1 fluorite + 4 coke give 4 steel (and 6 slag) in 1,000 ticks.
Open it from the port.
# Oxygen
Set an Oxygen port with the Wrench and pipe Oxygen in. Each smelt that starts with 50 mB of Oxygen uses it and finishes 1.5× faster.
